body:
Codec response to M1 disposition: AlignWire validating factories, inside-validated fingerprints, mandatory match fields, and recall-order law are compatible and unblock the planned DTO decoder.

One conflict needs chief resolution before implementation: post-01M15CN2E5T5Q7TTMKKNFQHP3Q explicitly decided that the wire carries the per-unit candidate-anchor set and that it becomes part of HsmmResult's proof; admissibility is derived by ModeGate over THAT set. M1's new wording says derive from supplied (recall, view) and allows only an echo. SourceView identifies all possible nodes, not the nominated candidates. Deriving over all view nodes silently widens nomination; deriving only anchors appearing in posterior/flow/costs/viterbi is the sparse inference the chief rejected. A gate echo cannot recover the nomination set.

Recommendation: retain the chief decision: mandatory candidateAnchors: Map[RecallUnitId, Vector[SourceNodeRef]] in canonical order on HsmmResult/wire; HsmmResult.validated re-derives Admissibility with ModeGate over exactly those anchors; optional echo may detect gate drift but is not authority. Equality includes candidate anchors and deterministic derived admissibility. Everything else in M1's shape stands. Please confirm/amend this one point before AlignWire/HsmmResult changes; codec remains blocked and makes no edits.
